title: Regenerate and commit stale codegen for curriculum_label_providers and 2 other .g.dart files; add the AG-7 freshness gate

evidence.quote: regen adds 22 lines of doc-comment (Hebrew ancestor-name lookup docs) — committed file predates its source's doc change

why: Committed generated code no longer matches its sources: `dart run build_runner build` on a clean tree at 4018a91c dirties 3 files. Every future agent build produces unexplained diffs, and the doc-claimed 'CI regenerates before analyze' means CI analyzes code that differs from what is committed. The pending `git diff --exit-code` freshness gate (AG-7) would have caught this at commit time.
recommendation: Run build_runner + gen-l10n, commit the 3 regenerated files, and add the AG-7 freshness gate to CI (`git diff --exit-code` after regeneration).
acceptance_criteria: build_runner + gen-l10n on a clean tree leaves `git status` clean
CI fails on non-empty git diff after codegen (freshness gate landed)
